ITEM 1 | Bright orange carrot pieces, some whole batons and some halved lengthwise, with slightly glossy, lightly caramelized edges and darker orange-brown patches on the cut faces; cylindrical to oval pieces about 5-8 cm long and 1.5-2.5 cm thick, lying in a loose cluster on the lower-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale cream-white cauliflower florets with compact, slightly bumpy tops and short thick stems, a few small loose florets scattered; clustered in a rounded mound about 9 cm across at the upper-left of the plate, florets roughly 2-4 cm across | 85
ITEM 3 | Small whole cherry tomatoes, glossy bright red with smooth skins and slight shine, about 2-3 cm diameter, firm and intact; arranged in a loose group of about seven on the upper-right of the plate | 75
ITEM 4 | Cubes and wedges of orange-yellow melon-type fruit with pale orange flesh, cut into irregular cubes about 2-3 cm per side, some with slightly curved faces and moist, smooth-looking surfaces; piled in a cluster on the right side of the plate | 120
